categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Modifies files under src/ipc/test/fuzz/ to improve IPC fuzzing infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Expands the IPC fuzz target to exercise malformed payload deserialization and bidirectional callbacks. The PR description notes that earlier fuzzing only tested round-trips with valid data, so this improves testing of cross-boundary serialization robustness, though it remains reasonably deferrable test coverage.
